story.text: 번화한 거리 한쪽에 자리 잡은 작은 카페의 문을 열자, 고소한 원두 향이 확 풍겨왔다.
story.reading: beon-hwa-han geo-ri han-jjok-e ja-ri jab-eun jak-eun ka-pe-ui mun-eul yeol-ja, go-so-han won-du hyang-i hwak pung-gyeo-wat-da.
story.en: As I opened the door of a small cafe tucked into a busy street, the nutty scent of coffee beans rushed out.

story.text: "자, 오늘은 아가씨가 직접 주문해 볼까요?" 규현이 카운터 쪽으로 슬쩍 등을 떠밀며 장난스럽게 웃었다.
story.reading: "ja, o-neul-eun a-ga-ssi-ga jik-jeop ju-mun-hae bol-kka-yo?" gyu-hyeon-i ka-un-teo jjok-eu-ro seul-jjeok deung-eul tteo-mil-myeo jang-nan-seu-reop-ge us-eot-da.
story.en: "So, why don't you try ordering yourself today?" Kyuhyun gave me a light push toward the counter, grinning mischievously.

story.text: 메뉴판을 훑어보던 내가 머뭇거리자, 그가 슬쩍 다가와 귓가에 속삭였다. "이럴 땐 그냥 '아메리카노 한 잔 주세요' 하면 되는데요."
story.reading: me-nyu-pan-eul hult-eo-bo-deon nae-ga meo-mut-geo-ri-ja, geu-ga seul-jjeok da-ga-wa gwit-ga-e sok-sag-yeot-da. "i-reol ttaen geu-nyang 'a-me-ri-ka-no han jan ju-se-yo' ha-myeon doe-neun-de-yo."
story.en: As I scanned the menu and hesitated, he leaned in close and whispered, "In a case like this, you just say 'One Americano, please.'"

story.text: 직원이 웃으며 물었다. "사이즈는 어떻게 해드릴까요?" 나는 규현을 흘끗 보았고, 그는 눈짓으로 '톨'이라고 말하라는 신호를 보냈다.
story.reading: jig-won-i us-eu-myeo mul-eot-da. "sa-i-jeu-neun eo-ttteo-ke hae-deu-ril-kka-yo?" na-neun gyu-hyeon-eul heul-kkeut bo-at-go, geu-neun nun-jit-eu-ro 'tol'-i-ra-go mal-ha-ra-neun sin-ho-reul bo-naet-da.
story.en: The staff member asked with a smile, "What size would you like?" I glanced at Kyuhyun, who signaled with his eyes to say 'tall.'

story.text: "여기서 드시고 가세요, 포장이세요?" 라는 물음에 내가 멈칫하자, 규현이 대신 대답했다. "포장으로 해주세요. 우리 갈 데가 있거든요."
story.reading: "yeo-gi-seo deu-si-go ga-se-yo, po-jang-i-se-yo?" ra-neun mul-eum-e nae-ga meom-chit-ha-ja, gyu-hyeon-i dae-sin dae-dab-haet-da. "po-jang-eu-ro hae-ju-se-yo. u-ri gal de-ga it-geo-deun-yo."
story.en: "For here, or to go?" I froze at the question, and Kyuhyun answered for me. "To go, please. We've got somewhere to be."

story.text: 완성된 커피를 받아 든 나는 한 모금 마시고 살짝 인상을 찌푸렸다. "얼음을 너무 많이 넣었나 봐요." 그러자 규현이 낮게 웃으며 말했다. "다음엔 '얼음 조금만 넣어 주세요' 해봐요. 그래서, 오늘 첫 주문은 성공적이었다고 봐도 되죠?"
story.reading: wan-seong-doen keo-pi-reul bad-a deun na-neun han mo-geum ma-si-go sal-jjak in-sang-eul jji-pu-ryeot-da. "eol-eum-eul neo-mu man-i neoh-eot-na bwa-yo." geu-reo-ja gyu-hyeon-i nat-ge us-eu-myeo mal-haet-da. "da-eum-en 'eol-eum jo-geum-man neoh-eo ju-se-yo' hae-bwa-yo. geu-rae-seo, o-neul cheot ju-mun-eun seong-gong-jeog-i-eot-da-go bwa-do doe-jyo?"
story.en: Taking the finished coffee, I sipped it and winced slightly. "I think they put in too much ice." Kyuhyun laughed quietly. "Next time, try saying 'Just a little ice, please.' So — I guess we can call today's first order a success?"

story.text: 창가 자리에 마주 앉아 커피를 홀짝이는 동안, 규현은 계속 흐뭇한 얼굴로 나를 지켜보고 있었다.
story.reading: chang-ga ja-ri-e ma-ju anj-a keo-pi-reul hol-jjag-i-neun dong-an, gyu-hyeon-eun gye-sok heu-mut-han eol-gul-lo na-reul ji-kyeo-bo-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: As we sat facing each other by the window, sipping our coffee, Kyuhyun kept watching me with a satisfied look on his face.

words.example_en: I ordered coffee at the cafe.
Please make it a tall size.

sentences.en: Please put in just a little ice.
